Definition: from G4540; a Samarite, i.e. inhabitant of Samaria:--Samaritan.
BiblicalUsage: Samaritan is an inhabitant of Samaria. You find the name in Luke 10:33, "…a certain Samaritan, as he journeyed, came where…", and again in John 8:48 and Acts 8:25 — in the SBL text the word is spelled Σαμαρίτης.
TheologicalSignificance: My position is that Samaritan counts, because God wrote the name down and I believe he meant it. I hold that no name in Scripture is there by accident.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
